summary: This Dockerfile creates a container image based on Ubuntu that installs GIMP (an image editing application) and runs it by default when the container starts. It's a minimal setup that prevents interactive prompts during installation and cleans up package cache to keep the image size smaller.

explanations.3: This tells the package manager to run in non-interactive mode so it won't pause waiting for user input during installation — important because containers can't receive keyboard input.
explanations.5: The 'apt-get update' refreshes the package list, 'apt-get install' adds GIMP, the '--no-install-recommends' flag skips optional dependencies to save space, and the 'rm -rf' at the end deletes the package cache files we no longer need after installation.
